design: Exact degree<=8 polynomial in shared amplitude s of frozen context shifts, all four probes, both incoming/readout choices. Fixed truncation orders0-8; coefficients recursively propagated through native and shift maps. Controls: constant/native, first-order/additive, full/full-predictor, direct s=.5 and-1 original receiver-input.
limitations: Interaction order counts distinct shifted layers in a local tangent chain, not finite activation Taylor order. Sum of all pairs/triples, not selected circuits. No fitting or subset selection.
